translations.text: Our lord, highest of mighty kings, has appointed for himself to come here on the greatest day; then the ruler of mankind will burn up the land with fire. That is no small matter to speak of.
No greater terror can come about in the world, and it will be widely known.
No star will shine here, but glory will have passed away, and the riches of the earth with it. Therefore I will always teach people to praise God's glory on high,
when men and women leave the world and the misery of earth; then they will look upon what they have earned for eternity.
He who wishes to live with God, and to enjoy the dwelling that the bright Father, the lord of spirits, prepares for us, must not be too slow, nor too sluggish in these teachings.
It is the Lord of victory who adorns that hall and builds it splendidly. The pure, free of stains, shall [go] there, as the Ruler, King of all kings, said.
Therefore every living one among the deep-minded obeys the Lord, every one of those who wish to ascend to the height of the heavens.
Yet it will come to pass, though it be covered with dust, the body with clay, that it shall receive life, life after the earth.
The people will be summoned, all the children of Adam, to give account; then spirit and bone-house will be gathered, joined together for that journey.
Truth will make that known when we meet on the greatest day, men at the cross. Then they will tell many true things,
everything of hot and cold, of good or evil, that has happened under heaven; the highest of heavenly kings will listen closely to the deeds of men.

No one will ever sound a horn so loud or blow a trumpet so hard that the bright voice, the Ruler's word, will not be louder to people over all the earth. The plains will tremble at the message that he assigns to us all.
Answer this saying now. It shall be made known that I cannot turn aside what is fated under heaven, but it shall happen like this to every people over all the bright dwellings: burning fire.
Then, after the fire, life will be established; whoever thinks well now will have riches in glory.
